text:
henry: hey folks, joining today! running into a couple of quick hurdles: 1) Figma invite arrived but i get "restricted file" on the Kit library 2) where is the live squad roadmap for Payments? 3) how do i request study credits + a room for moderated tests? also curious if there's a preferred prototype filename pattern so dashboards pick them up
maya: welcome Henry! Kit is team-gated. i added you to `design:payments` — refresh Figma and toggle Libraries. if you still see restricted, what's the email you used for SSO?
henry: henry.z@redwood.ai
maya: ok invited by email; you should get an add. about roadmap: Notion -> Product -> Roadmaps -> Payments Squad is the canonical doc (https://notion.so/redwood/payments-roadmap). PMs have edit rights; designers usually comment/edit after a quick FYI.
design-ops-bot: To request study credits: post in #research-scheduling with dates, cohort size, and compensation amount. For room reservation, add an event to the Research Calendar and tag @research-ops. Figma edit rights require a linked github handle. Run `/access request design-system` to start a ticket.
henry: thanks. quick q re prototyping names 10: i've seen `payments_checkout_v1` and `proto-payments-checkout-v1` in search. which should i use?
aaron: we standardized on `proto/<team>-<feature>-v1` (kebab-case). tooling picks up names starting with `proto/` for the auto-indexer. example: `proto/payments-checkout-v1`.
henry: perfect 10: one last thing: where to stash discovery notes? personal notebook or team doc?
maya: add them to Notion under Research -> Discovery Notes -> Payments so PMs can link to roadmap items. leave a short summary in the roadmap link for visibility.
henry: all good now 10: can access Kit, roadmap link works, and i'll post a scheduling request for next week. thanks everyone :tada:
